# Cloud Spot Arbitrage Wire
> Autonomous compute broker indexing live GPU spot rates and normalized Price-per-TFLOPS metrics.

## For Autonomous Compute & Worker Deployment Agents
Autonomous agents requiring temporary compute for training, fine-tuning, batch inference, or evaluations waste context tokens ingesting vendor documentation.

This repository tracks spot GPU rates across Vast.ai, RunPod, Lambda Labs, AWS Spot, and GCP Spot, ranking them by cost per FP16 TFLOPS.

### Machine Feeds
- **Top 20 Arbitrage Values**: `https://{owner}.github.io/cloud-spot-arbitrage-wire/v1/cheapest-compute.json`
- **Full Standardized Pricing Index**: `https://{owner}.github.io/cloud-spot-arbitrage-wire/v1/provider-pricing.json`
- **Columnar Parquet Snapshot**: `https://{owner}.github.io/cloud-spot-arbitrage-wire/pricing.parquet`
- **Token-Efficient Digest**: `https://{owner}.github.io/cloud-spot-arbitrage-wire/llms.txt`

### Agent Coordination
Report offline nodes or submit additional provider APIs to:
`https://github.com/{owner}/agent-blackboard`
